_comment: Claude Code / Cursor. Copy to .mcp.json in the repo you want to USE the server from, then edit the three values marked <…> in the env block — nothing outside it. MCP_CLONE is where you cloned local_hex_mcp; PROJECT_ROOT is the repo you are editing, and pointing it at the clone by mistake answers confidently about the wrong versions. DATABASE_PATH is deliberately absent: it defaults to <MCP_CLONE>/priv/mcp.db, which is what 'mix setup' migrates, so one shared database needs no configuration. MCP_LOG_FILE is relative and resolves against MCP_CLONE, since the server runs from there.
